summary: WM Technology, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the adjournment of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders until July 16, 2026, to allow more time for stockholders to vote on a proposal to declassify the Board of Directors and provide for immediate annual election of all directors. No business was conducted at the original meeting. This filing pertains to a routine corporate governance proposal and meeting logistics. No special situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, or change of control—is involved. The registrant is the issuer. There are no deal terms reported.
